author: Fareed
description: Per-user gambling threads to keep the shared bot channel clean, plus the Wondercasino hub: a read-only channel with a persistent button/dropdown menu (.gamblehub) that routes players into personal or shared threads instead of letting them post directly. .gamble opens a private thread; it auto-closes after inactivity or .endgambling. Also hosts the Wonderland pixel canvas (Pixel Canvas in the hub's More… menu; mods: .gamblehub canvas), a coin sink.
short: Per-user gambling threads plus the Wondercasino hub menu.
end_user_data_statement: The pixel canvas stores, per guild in the cog's data folder: every painted pixel (position, colour, the owner's user ID, price, time, and any text up to 100 characters), a permanent log of each paint (user ID, position, coins paid, colour, text, time), the user IDs mods have banned from painting, and the time of the last weekly post. Wiping a member or resetting the canvas blanks pixels but keeps the paint log. The rest of the cog stores channel and message IDs and open thread IDs.
